title: US scientists lose clearances while Nazis are put in charge
summary: Peter Levenda tells of US scientists lose clearances while Nazis are put in charge, about late 1940s-1950s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> everybody that actually worked for us during the war lost their security clearances right so Oenheimer loses his security clearance Jack Parsons loses his right

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a writer and researcher named Peter Levenda says that in the late 1940s and 1950s, Americans who had worked for the United States during the Second World War lost their security clearances, the official permission to handle secret work. He names the physicist Robert Oppenheimer and the rocket engineer Jack Parsons, and says that former Nazi scientists were put in charge instead. If true, it would mean the country's most secret projects were handed to its former enemies.
